name: workflow
description: Four on-demand specialists for change quality, commit structure and documentation, plus working-conventions: the standing conventions the global AGENTS.md routing table points to.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect quality, structure commits, refresh docs and follow standing conventions.
interface.longDescription: Four on-demand skills (anti-slop, decompose-feature, ensure-atomic-pr, refresh-related-docs) assess change quality, propose coherent commit sequences, inspect commit atomicity and correct related documentation. working-conventions holds the standing rules and project-docs templates that a routing-only AGENTS.md points to.
defaultPrompt: Use a specialist when it helps; read the working-conventions reference AGENTS.md routes to.
